title: Sync-path health sample set
description: A bounded set of sync-path samples for one cabinet: a short ICMP echo series paired with TCP connect attempts to the same destination. The server fills the targets from the site's sync cabinet setting and the platform endpoint; a sample names a destination only by its index into that list and carries no host and no port of its own, so no report can introduce a free-form target or an arbitrary port. The interpretation rules are part of the contract: a series with no reply carries null round-trip figures, never zero, and ICMP silence while a TCP connect succeeds is packet filtering, never packet loss.

collectedAt.description: When the platform assembled this set (the newest sample's time or later).

targets.description: The only destinations the platform samples: the cabinet's approved same-site sync endpoint and the platform endpoint. Filled in by the server from settings, never from a request, and never more than four sync ports plus the platform endpoint.

state.description: What the platform knew about this cabinet's heartbeat and sync at collection time. Filled in by the server, never by a report.

samples.description: Oldest first, at most 24 per target (24 hourly samples) and at most 120 in the set. Empty is a valid set: a window retention has cleared measures nothing, and the report says so instead of reading health from it.

address.description: The destination address, checked to be a private address on the cabinet's own network for the sync cabinet. Never a host name: a name would have to be resolved, and a resolved destination is revalidated before it is used.

port.description: The service port to connect to: one of the site's configured sync ports for the sync cabinet, or the platform endpoint's own port. Null when only ICMP is sampled. Never a value the console or an agent chooses.

minutesSilent.description: Minutes since the cabinet last checked in; null when it has never checked in or that is not known.

targetIndex.description: Index into the set's targets array. There is no other way to name a destination.

result.description: How the attempt as a whole went: reached, a timeout with no reply, a refusal, a destination the network could not reach, or a local error. It must agree with the series below: a timeout with a successful connect, a refusal with no refusal counted, or a reached with nothing answered is refused by the server's check (the schema cannot state that).

allOf.description: A sample must carry at least one measurement; a sample that measured nothing is not a sample.

icmpSeries.description: An ICMP echo series to one target: what was sent, what came back, and the round-trip spread when something did.

allOf.description: No reply means the round-trip figures are null, never zero: a zero would read as an impossibly fast reply.

tcpSeries.description: A TCP connect series to one target's port: how many attempts were made and how they ended. A refused or timed-out connect is not an IP packet measurement.

allOf.description: No connection means the connect-time figures are null, never zero.

nullableMs.description: A round-trip time in milliseconds, or null when nothing came back.
